name: Tennis no Ouji-sama: Doubles no Ouji-sama
original_name: テニスの王子様 ダブルスの王子様
source:
Join the doubles championship with the princes of tennis in Girls be Gracious! Featuring teams from the anime series, choose a partner and play against the others. In the doubles championship, you need to train with your partner, get to know him better and get closer to him.

[Edited from [url=http://www.playimport.com/zh/preowned-games/4867-the-prince-of-tennis-doubles-no-oji-sama-girls-be-gracious-4988602146059.html]playimport.com[/url]]
translation:
在《Girls be Gracious》中与网球王子一起参加双打锦标赛！以动漫系列中的队伍为特色，选择一个伙伴并与其他人对战。在双打锦标赛中，你需要和你的搭档一起训练，更加了解他，更加接近他。

[编辑自[url=http://www.playimport.com/zh/preowned-games/4867-the-prince-of-tennis-doubles-no-oji-sama-girls-be-gracious-4988602146059.html]playimport.com[/url]]
